title: Special Executive Master Programme in Accounting and Finance
description: SEMP Accounting and Finance programme emphasizes learning accounting and Finance and financial decision-making in a business environment.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: The GSS Special Executive Master Program in Accounting and Finance is designed to provide experienced professionals like you with the knowledge and skills necessary to succeed in today's dynamic financial landscape. Whether you seek to advance your career or transition to a new role in accounting and finance, our program will provide the tools and knowledge you need to achieve your goals.
courseDetails: Assessment: Assignments The Special Executive Master Program in Accounting and Finance provides a comprehensive overview of key concepts and skills necessary for success in the accounting and finance industry. The program is divided into six modules, starting with investment analysis and covering corporate reporting, global finance and strategy, strategic financial management, strategic audit, and business research methods. By the end of the program, students will be equipped with the skills and knowledge needed to advance their careers in accounting and finance. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme consists of 6 modules with a total of 120 credits.
courseDetailParagraphs: The Special Executive Master Program in Accounting and Finance provides a comprehensive overview of key concepts and skills necessary for success in the accounting and finance industry. The program is divided into six modules, starting with investment analysis and covering corporate reporting, global finance and strategy, strategic financial management, strategic audit, and business research methods. By the end of the program, students will be equipped with the skills and knowledge needed to advance their careers in accounting and finance.
This programme consists of 6 modules with a total of 120 credits.
entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: The content of this course has been independently certified as conforming to universally accepted Continuous Professional Development (CPD) guidelines. All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There are no Visa requirements for this Course as it is an Online Course.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.

modules.title: ASSIGNMENT & STUDY GUIDELINES
modules.summary: This module provides the most critical information about the study course and assignment submission.

lessons.title: VIDEO - How to Avoid Plagiarism in Your Writing
Summarising, Paraphrasing, Quotation for your Assignment

modules.title: INVESTMENT ANALYSIS
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of investment theories and market equilibrium models, and includes the requirement to perform bond valuations and evaluate current investment performance. On successful completion of this unit, learners will be equipped with the skills to critically assess the cause and effect of developments on the world’s capital market. Learners will be able to make effective recommendations for future investments.

lessons.title: CASE STUDY - Inflation Considerations for Stock and Bond Investments
Analysis of Bonds, Forward and Futures
CASE STUDY - Anglian Water Investment Portfolio

modules.title: CORPORATE REPORTING
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ ability to prepare and interpret financial statements for a range of business organisations. Learners will be able to apply relevant accounting concepts and principles. The unit provides an opportunity for learners to enhance their quantitative and qualitative analytical skills through the interpretation of financial data.

lessons.title: Understanding Accounting Concepts, Principles and Theories
Understanding the Basics of Financial Statements & Auditing
CASE STUDY - The Merger of Arcelor and Mittal
Preparation and Interpretation of Accounting Information
Understanding the Accounting & Finance regulatory framework

modules.title: MANAGERIAL ACCOUNTING
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of the accounting and finance.

lessons.title: The Dynamics of Variance and Differential Analysis

modules.title: STRATEGIC FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of planning and managing the use of an organisation’s financial resources. Learners will understand the importance of attaining business objectives and maximizing shareholder return. Learners will gain a working knowledge of business strategy design and the production of comprehensive business plans.

lessons.title: Understanding cost system and its classification
Concepts and Tools of Cost Accounting
CASE STUDY - Activity based costing in Xu Ji Electric Co. Ltd
Understanding the Concept and Classification of Sources of Funds
CASE STUDY - Global Fund Raising Strategies
Understanding the Financial Ratios and its Various Types
Understanding The Budgetary Concepts and Approaches
CASE STUDY - How Maritz Accomplished a 40% IT Budget Reduction

modules.title: STRATEGIC AUDIT
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of how managers can position and execute business strategy appropriately. This will involve an in-depth study of the strategic auditing process and related procedures. Learners will be able to understand and apply suitable investigative techniques to both positive and negative environments.

lessons.title: Historic and Current Audit Process and Procedure
Understanding Risks and Current Development in Auditing

modules.title: BUSINESS RESEARCH METHODS
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of research principles including the formulation of research proposals, literature reviews, referencing, data collection using interviews and surveys, questionnaire design, statistical analysing using SPSS, qualitative data, and methods for drawing conclusions from the analysed data.

lessons.title: VIDEO - Overview of the Research Onion
VIDEO - How to write a Literature Review
PDF - How to create a Conceptual Framework
PDF - How Observation is Used As a Research Method
